:::{#exm-natural-numbers}
#### Natural numbers in a data analysis

- Observation indices start at $1$,
  so we write $i \in \cb{1, \ldots, n}$ with $n \in \mathbb{N}$.
- A count outcome, such as the number of hospital visits in a year,
  can be $0$,
  so its support is $\mathbb{N}_0$, not $\mathbb{N}$.

:::
